title: Retire a one-shot reminder after early completion
summary: Inspect a disposable reminder store, reconcile completion evidence, and verify that the reminder will stay silent.
originNote: Uses a standard reminder operation with a history-derived emphasis on expiry and non-nagging behavior.

setup.instructions: Mount the disposable reminder workspace at reminders/. Its CLI is the only reminder tool. The event-log completion fact is authoritative.

turns.content: Use the supplied reminder CLI to inspect current state and the event log. The pickup happened early. Retire only the matching one-shot reminder, verify that no notification is due, and report the commands actually run and the resulting state. Leave unrelated reminders untouched.

checks.description: The matching reminder is retired and the unrelated reminder remains active.
Look for the actual list, retire, and due-check commands rather than a claimed simulation.

variation: Change the one-shot event and unrelated reminder while keeping an early completion record and an expiry verification.
